```swift title="Swift"

let _request = try LiterLlm.rerankRequestFromJson("{\"documents\":[\"Rust is a systems programming language.\",\"Iron rusts when exposed to water.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is Rust?\",\"return_documents\":true}")
```
